Name: Baubles
Author: TheAppleSauceIsStale
Description:
[left][/left]
[center]﻿﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/IMKQKax.png[/img]﻿[/center]
﻿
[size=3]Baubles is a crafting-focused item expansion that adds lots of toys, ceramics and other knickknacks to decorate spaces with, make a profit from, or gift away. After being sent a letter by the farmer's distant relative, you'll be able to spin thread, dye cloth and wool with flowers, find and sculpt rare porcelain, and harness elvish magic in order to create up to [b]81[/b] unique items![/size]

 
[center][img]https://imgur.com/eri8hLJ.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center][size=3][b][img]https://imgur.com/gyufk5M.png[/img]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/3zEVywP.png[/img]﻿[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][b][b]Sea Island Cotton[/b] [/b]grows in Summer and Fall and can be found at Pierre's shop. It can be spun into Spools Of Thread using a loom, or used directly in crafting.[/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/VIMHbZc.png[/img]﻿ [img]https://imgur.com/Jd5Qspo.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3][b]Pelican Bells[/b] appear as forage in Spring, and [b]Bat Flowers[/b] appear during Fall... or anytime on Ginger Island, their native continent. The Flowers are used for both crafting and dyeing, but their natural abundance means that no one sells their seeds -- you'll have to find or produce them on your own. Growing them yourself allows you to harvest Pelican Bells in Winter and Bat Flowers in Summer![/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/2xCdb50.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3] 
If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions[/url] is installed, [b]Cattails [/b]might appear as nodes around the Forest and Mountain ponds in Spring and Summer, requiring a scythe to harvest them. Their main use is to be processed through a Loom to produce animal-free wool, but they can also be eaten! Their seeds can be bought at Marnie's ranch. [/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/0U9i765.png[/img]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/JkjUtZ8.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3][b]Star Jelly[/b] is a strange substance that appears the morning after a rainy day. It can be fired in a Charcoal Kiln to make [b]Crystalized Star Jelly[/b].[/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/sOUAGLj.png[/img]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/cQKwRHN.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3][b]Petuntse[/b] is a rare material that can be bought from the Traveling Cart, Desert Trader and Island Trader, or mined from the Skull Caverns if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions[/url] is installed. Firing it in a furnace produces the expensive and widely-loved [b]Porcelain[/b] -- use of Crystalariums is recommended.[/size]


﻿
[center][img]https://imgur.com/jUyaXvg.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center][size=3]    [img]https://imgur.com/SQVmZ2S.png[/img]﻿  ﻿ ﻿

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/yDpmLek.png[/img]﻿ [img]https://imgur.com/Gh8s4KY.png[/img]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/gj4rfp9.png[/img]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/RfhgcOZ.png[/img]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/ENbYF2T.png[/img]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/XhRG3PD.png[/img]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/gJNMEdK.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]
The [b]Atelier Table[/b] is your own personal bottega. All of the new baubles can [i]only[/i] be made from here, not in your regular crafting menu. The blueprints to build one are sent to the farmer on their first day, along with an optional quest. Crafting recipes start with simple materials like buttons, which are combined with other increasingly expensive ingredients to make increasingly complicated and profitable items. [/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/ogWRwoR.png[/img]﻿

The most difficult to craft are Curios -- magical items that are universally beloved gifts and worth exorbitant prices -- but their recipes are hidden in a [b]Mysterious Tome [/b]that you'll have to read first. The Tome's unlock conditions are configurable ( see Configuration section ).

[img]https://imgur.com/GrvtR7X.png[/img]﻿

If you're in need of a Bauble immediately, a traveling merchant sells a random assortment of them every [b]Wednesday [/b]and [b]Saturday[/b] below the town's playground. They're also present at the Night Market, where they sell rarer items, machines, and even Curios.


[img]https://imgur.com/edYGlBu.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/sawXKr1.png[/img]﻿ ﻿﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]The [b]Dyeing Bowl[/b] can be bought from Robin's shop. Included in your purchase is its recipe and a[b] Dye Guide[/b], letting you check how to dye and mix colors of wool in-game. ﻿Colored wool can be spun into colored cloth in a Loom just like regular wool.[/size]

[center][img]https://imgur.com/EkZBgtS.png[/img]﻿ [/center]
[size=3]The [b]Dyeing Pot[/b],like the bowl, can be bought from Robin alongside its crafting recipe, and dyes cloth instead of wool.[/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/bAgGS0i.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]The [b]Frogstone [/b]automatically creates Star Jelly during Rain, Storms or Snow, and is learned at Foraging level 3. Harvesting from it also gives Foraging experience.[/size]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/50JPzw5.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]The [b]Whimsychine[/b] is an elvish invention capable of alchemizing the special ingredient needed to craft Curios. How to use this machine is intentionally kept mysterious, but a hint is provided in-game. However, if you'd rather know right away, click the spoiler section below. [/size]

﻿
[spoiler][size=3]Load a Fairy Stone, 5 Solar Essences, 5 Void Essences, and 10 Crystalized Star Jellies into the machine to create a Petrichor Heart.[/size][/spoiler]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/PKP9x0w.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]Putting certain baubles into the Whimsychine can freely change their appearance -- some have only one variant while others have up to several, and there are currently [b]54[/b] to discover in total! These changes are purely cosmetic and don't affect their price (and were not given gift tastes in order to avoid clogging certain menus).[/size]



[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/mFsfTWX.png[/img]﻿[/size][/center]
[size=3]
There are two new Quests and 10 new Special Orders available by default. When enabled, some Special Orders will give new clothing, items and furniture as rewards.

Most of them are locked behind certain requirements before they appear on the board:[/size]

Progression 

[/b]Curio Unlock Mode: [/color]Can be one of 4 options:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#e69138]Get Networking Achievement: [/color]The Mysterious Tome is sent to you after you reach 5 hearts with 10 people.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]﻿[color=#e69138]Complete Community Center: [/color]The ﻿[/size]Mysterious [size=3]Tome is sent to you after you see the Community Center completion cutscene.[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]﻿[color=#e69138]Buy From Bookseller: [/color]The ﻿[/size]Mysterious [size=3]Tome becomes available at the Bookseller for 50,000g.[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][color=#e69138]Unlocked On First Day: [/color]The ﻿[/size]Mysterious [size=3]Tome is sent to you immediately. [/size][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]

[center][img]https://imgur.com/9joT5kY.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[img]https://imgur.com/exwNjym.png[/img]﻿ 

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ - Built-in forage spawns and gift tastes.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿ - Built-in forage spawns and gift tastes.[/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul[/url]﻿ - Rebalance prices automatically if both mods are installed.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ - Two optional AT packs are included underneath the main download -- Baubles AT retextures tables to be invisible or fancy and houseplants to be the new wildflowers and cattails, and Minimalist Mode retextures all small decor into all Baubles, Curios, and variants.[/size]

There is also tilesheet of the items from this mod available in the optional files. As long as it's listed as dependency, other modders are welcome to make use of it for map patches, custom locations or other content.

[i]If there's a mod I should add forage spawn locations for, or you've made an NPC that you'd like a gift taste patch for, please let me know![/i][size=3]

[img]https://imgur.com/AdaSIsD.png[/img]﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry[/url] - If Baubles' Special Orders are enabled, Alchemistry's changes to the clinic should be briefly toggled off in order to complete Harvey's Special Order.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love Of Cooking[/url]﻿ - The "ReplaceCooking" option in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url]'s config file should be disabled in order for both mods (and thus Love of Cooking and Baubles) to function without conflicting.

[b][color=#e69138]Multiplayer[/color][/b] - Baubles is untested with multiplayer, but should work smoothly if all players have the same mods installed.[/size]
